trigger.description: The operator passed --replace-manual-with-auto so SRR6.46.3 migrated the workspace from manual to auto-managed lifecycle, but the peer set the autodiscovery candidates picked DIFFERS from the existing manual peer set hash. Materialization went through; this code surfaces so the operator can review the divergence before relying on the new auto-managed group (the manual config may have included peers the autodiscovery filter would have excluded, or vice versa).
setup_commands: ee mesh peer add <node-key> --workspace .   # manual configuration that includes peers not visible to autodiscovery, or omits peers autodiscovery would find

message_contains: differs from the existing manual peer set
